run_train_votenet: run the VoteNet training script for 3D object detection on SUN RGB-D or ScanNet datasets
train_one_epoch: train the 3D object detection model for one epoch with learning rate adjustment and batch norm decay
evaluate_one_epoch: evaluate the trained model on the test set and compute average precision metrics
train_start_epoch: train the model from a specified start epoch with checkpoint loading and periodic evaluation
adjust_learning_rate: adjust the optimizer learning rate based on epoch number with configurable decay steps and rates
